info.title: online
info.description: Block until the internet — or a named endpoint — is actually healthy (captive-portal-aware network-readiness gate).

options.name: --internet
options.description: Wait for working internet (layered, captive-portal-aware). Default when no check flag is given.

options.name: --once
options.description: Run one cycle and exit (no waiting): exit 0 ready, 1 not ready

options.name: --status
options.description: Expected status for --url: 2xx (default), list 200,204, or range 200-299

options.name: --url
options.description: Wait until URL returns a status matching --status (repeatable)

options.name: --endpoint
options.description: Override the built-in 204 connectivity endpoints for --internet (repeatable)

options.name: --describe
options.description: Structured JSON metadata for AI agents

options.name: --color
options.description: Coloured output: auto (default when omitted), always, or never
